item.title: First Project Seeking Greenlight: Physics-Based Anomalous Twins "Amp and Damp"
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlight: Yes

Page Type: SCP

Elevator Pitch:
-Pair of twins, one absorbs energy, one can manifest it, abilities balance by transferring energy between them

Narrative: Twins are discovered and cooperate completely with Foundation experimentation efforts and containment protocols. Eventually, they are used as a part of an MTF in missions against non-anomalous hostiles, as they can make use of one nigh indestructible team member and another with advanced offensive capability. During a breach at their site, the twins accidentally make things worse in an attempt to protect staff from hostile entities.

Twins are then contained involuntarily using the simplest means available, namely, forcing the two to share an extremely small physical space, as the balancing property of their abilities prevents them from using them in close contact with one another. An early researcher on the subject has empathy for the two and makes a proposal to the O-5 council to give them a less restrictive containment solution, while using them for foundation benefit. A scenario is orchestrated in which the human with absorbing abilities escapes, under the belief that his twin dies in the process, though they are kept alive due to planning of their injuries in advance, and given a new identity through amnestic treatment. An MTF is commissioned to hunt the escaped twin, while the other is used as a power source at an off-planet Foundation facility.

Hook: The containment procedures call for the MTF hunting the escaped twin to terminate them by overwhelming their energy-absorbing ability, a method later revealed to be infeasible. The MTF is also required to notify "Red Rains" up to a half hour in advance of engagement, hinting at the significant communication delay between Earth and the other twin's location. The MTF is a pretense to input energy to power the other twin's facility, not an attempt to neutralize the subject. The aforementioned researcher persuades the O-5 council to leave the escaped twin monitored and frequently charged by attacks but uncontained, as data shows that the twin's efforts have consistently protected humans from threats, even before Foundation contact.

Final Note: The document ends with an recovered interview log where the interviewer is the escaped twin, having managed to temporarily capture a member of the MTF. It is revealed that at some point the other twin accidentally used more energy in powering their facility than was provided by the MTF's attacks, making the escaped twin aware of their survival.
